error_text: No isolated position to update margin.
justification: D23. The example sets ETH to 21x cross, then 21x isolated, then adds $1 isolated margin 'to the ETH position'. It runs on a flat ETH account (run order in run_python.sh), and with no ETH position there is nothing to add margin to, so real HL rejects updateIsolatedMargin as well. With an open ETH position instead, real HL rejects the cross->isolated switch; no starting state makes every call succeed on HL. The chain is not special-cased.

error_text: Withdrawal amount must be greater than the withdrawal fee.
justification: HL withdraw fee is $1; amount 1 nets zero; HL exact text unverified (D25). The TS README snippet calls withdraw3({amount: "1"}); with HL's $1 withdrawal fee the net amount is zero, so the request is rejected. The chain is not special-cased. The SDK throws on it and the verbatim snippet does not catch it; it is the snippet's last (3rd) SDK call, so the harness accepts the uncaught throw under D27.
